native_layout.slots: (u32 group, i32 base, float32 growth) at +0x30 and +0x3C

semantics.current_clan_bonus: The compared clan ID equals native current joined clan ID; +1 before the step-7 cap.

contract.identity: Join by native clan_id and effect_group_id, never by display names alone.
contract.rank_input: Use the rank belonging to the selected clan, not a global player rank.
contract.arrays: Index 0..9 is native rank index. other_clan/current_clan describe whether this ID equals the joined clan.
contract.availability: The complete native named catalog does not prove player unlock, legal slot selection or simultaneous activation.
contract.hidden_values: An empty native display is preserved. Raw values do not establish triggered buff magnitude or duration.
contract.contribution: Native rank uses stored contribution plus elapsed-time contribution for the joined clan. This export accepts rank index; elapsed-time conversion is not implemented.
contract.remaining_scope: Selection/unlock rules, duplicate-effect aggregation and final combat formulas are outside this definition catalog.
